keyEvents.text: Goal! Slavia Prague 0, Arsenal 1. Noni Madueke (Arsenal) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Viktor Gyökeres with a through ball.
David Moses (Slavia Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Slavia Prague 0, Arsenal 2. Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mikel Merino.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Ange N'Guessan replaces Danijel Sturm.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Mojmír Chytil replaces Mubarak Suleiman.
Ezri Konsa (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Mikulás Konecny replaces Tomás Vlcek.
Substitution, Arsenal. Cristhian Mosquera replaces Ezri Konsa.
Substitution, Arsenal. Christos Tzolis replaces Eberechi Eze.
Delay in match because of an injury Emmanuel Ayaosi (Slavia Prague).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Declan Rice (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. David Jurásek replaces Emmanuel Ayaosi.
Delay in match because of an injury Wiktor Nowak (Slavia Prague).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Arsenal. Jurriën Timber replaces Ben White.
Substitution, Arsenal. Martin Ødegaard replaces Viktor Gyökeres.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Stepán Chaloupek replaces David Moses.
Goal! Slavia Prague 1, Arsenal 2. Wiktor Nowak (Slavia Prague) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by David Jurásek with a cross.
Substitution, Arsenal. Max Dowman replaces Noni Madueke.
